project_09_verdict: APPROVED FOR ATOMIC NAMESPACE MIGRATION (PROJECT 04 / T1)
intent: Atomic rename of the governed Home training presentation keys from the legacy home.training.record.<record_id>.<field> namespace to the canonical training.record.<record_id>.<field> namespace. This package carries NO translation, NO retranslation, NO normalization and NO wording change of any kind: every row restates the currently effective EN and PT value verbatim so the build can assert byte-for-byte equivalence across the rename and fail closed on any drift.
scope_note: Covers exactly the nine currently published Home training records. The retired EMAR / Kre+ records (home.training.record.emar-*) are deliberately NOT migrated: they are retired-record residue with no generator consumer and no counterpart in data/training-opportunities.json.
